name: FS Tau

images.credit: Yang et al. 2020, Fig. 4a (crop: FS Tau A)

paper.title: High-resolution Near-infrared Polarimetry and Submillimeter Imaging of FS Tau A: Possible Streamers in Misaligned Circumbinary Disk System

paper.title: Hubble Space Telescope WFPC2 Imaging of FS Tauri and Haro 6-5B

images.note: PSF-subtracted H-band coronagraphic image of the FS Tau circumbinary disk (features 1-4 annotated by authors). Different instrument+epoch than held HiCIAO 2011 pol record.

paper.title: High-Resolution Optical and Near-Infrared Images of the FS Tauri Circumbinary Disk

images.note: HST/ACS F606W Stokes I closeup after binary PSF subtraction showing arms/cavities/arc (GO 10178, PI Hines). NOTE: instrument is ACS, not WFPC2 (obs section).

paper.title: High-Resolution Optical and Near-Infrared Images of the FS Tauri Circumbinary Disk

images.note: SAME PAPER as the held HiCIAO H-pol record but a different facility/band (archival ALMA 2013.1.00105.S): CO(2-1) mom0 (blue+red components) revealing streamers around FS Tau A. One-record-per-band rule permits this.

paper.title: High-resolution Near-infrared Polarimetry and Submillimeter Imaging of FS Tau A: Possible Streamers in Misaligned Circumbinary Disk System

notes: Young (2.8 Myr) T Tauri binary in Taurus; the held Subaru/HiCIAO H-band polarimetric composite of FS Tau A shows arm-like streamer structures (S1/S2) extending to ~240 au, interpreted as signposts of a misaligned circumbinary disk system (Yang et al. 2020).
